name: Swift Roman Hinglish (Base)
pros: Direct Roman Hinglish, high edge speed, 2x acoustic capacity over tiny

name: Hinglish Conformer-CTC (Large)
pros: Ultra fast non-autoregressive CTC decoding, low RAM (~140MB)
cons: Outputs Devanagari script; needs transliteration or GGUF C++ engine added to APK

name: Whisper Tiny Hinglish (Romanized)
pros: Ultra lightweight (46MB), instant CPU inference (RTF < 0.1), direct Roman output
cons: Low acoustic capacity (38M); struggles with wearable lapel noise and overlapping talk

name: Zero STT Hinglish (Medium)
pros: High accuracy on clean audio code-switching
cons: Massive RAM (>1.5 GB), slow on phone CPU (RTF ~1.0x), thermal throttling, mixed script
